## Overview
Infosys is a global IT services and consulting provider focused on digital transformation, cloud migration, application modernization, AI, data, and managed services. It is commonly evaluated against TCS, Wipro, HCLTech, Cognizant, and Accenture.

## Key Takeaways
- Strong enterprise delivery footprint across banking, retail, manufacturing, and technology sectors
- Cost optimization and vendor consolidation are key procurement themes
- AI-first services and cloud modernization are central to growth positioning
- Deal economics depend on offshore mix, automation commitments, and managed service scope

## Highlights
- Large global delivery model supports scalable transformation programs
- Infosys Cobalt and Topaz are core cloud and AI positioning themes
- Pricing should be benchmarked against Indian IT services peers

## Investment Focus Areas
- **Products**: Digital services, managed services, cloud modernization, consulting
- **AI & Cloud**: Infosys Topaz, Infosys Cobalt, data platforms, automation
- **Strategic Priorities**: Margin discipline, large deals, AI-led productivity, client mining
